proposed_comments.title: Bound dispatcher outlier storage

confidence.rationale: The original queue is unbounded; the replacement retains only the samples needed for reporting.

proposed_comments.body:
### Bound dispatcher outlier storage

**Severity:** `high`

The outlier queue retains every slow dispatcher sample even though the report renders only ten entries. Keeping a bounded top-N list and a separate total counter prevents long diagnostic sessions from growing memory without bound.

```suggestion
    private readonly object _dispatcherOutliersLock = new();
    private readonly List<DispatcherOutlierSample> _dispatcherOutliers = [];
```

proposed_comments.title: Track total outlier samples separately

confidence.rationale: The retained list is capped, so total count must be tracked independently.

proposed_comments.body:
### Track total outlier samples separately

**Severity:** `high`

After bounding retained outliers, the report still needs the total number of slow samples observed. A separate counter preserves that total without retaining every sample object.

```suggestion
    private long _dispatcherWaitFailures;
    private long _dispatcherOutlierSamples;
```

proposed_comments.title: Report bounded outliers with the total observed count

confidence.rationale: This avoids full-history allocation and sort while preserving the displayed sample total.

proposed_comments.title: Retain only the ten slowest dispatcher outliers

confidence.rationale: The insertion path bounds retained samples while retaining the ten longest outliers for the existing report.

proposed_comments.title: Do not keep a hidden session after ETW disables

confidence.rationale: This addresses the creation race by rechecking IsEnabled immediately after the hidden session is published.

proposed_comments.title: Replace cache entries atomically

confidence.rationale: TryUpdate prevents replacement notifications and writes when cleanup has already removed or replaced the entry.

proposed_comments.title: Support exact-entry cache removal

confidence.rationale: ConcurrentDictionary implements atomic exact pair removal through ICollection<KeyValuePair<TKey,TValue>>.

proposed_comments.title: Remove only the cleanup-scored cache entry

confidence.rationale: The call uses the scored key-entry pair so concurrent replacements remain in the cache.
